patch_list: Automatically presses Skip Intro and Skip Recap for you, so a binge does not stop to wait. Each can be turned off on its own. Experimental: the hook is in place and correct, but the skip has not yet been confirmed on a device, because Netf…

Adds a searchable list of Netflix's hidden genre categories (the netflix.com/browse/genre codes) and opens any of them inside the app, plus an optional "Surprise me" that opens a random one. Choose the entry points: a "Hidden Categories" l…

Keeps a patched (re-signed) Netflix build from killing its own process a few seconds after launch. Loads a bundled in-process native hook that blocks the fatal signal Netflix's native integrity guard raises against itself, so the app runs…
Stops Netflix from auto-playing preview trailers while you browse, and from auto-advancing to the next episode. Each can be turned off on its own.
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Keeps Netflix playing when you leave the app or turn off the screen, so you can keep listening in the background. Experimental and not yet confirmed on a device.
Stops Netflix from taking over your screen brightness during playback, so the phone keeps the brightness you set.
Keeps picture-in-picture available even when Netflix turns it off for your device, so a video can shrink to a floating window when you leave the app.
Removes the Clips (short videos) and/or Games tabs from the bottom navigation bar. Each can be removed on its own.
